epsp.support_definition: Raw EPSP strictly greater than the exact dimensionless zero threshold; no fitted threshold or clipping. Projected nodal support is not a raw-cell damage criterion.

history.definition: Strict time increments at fixed support; raw cumulative EPSP is expected not to decrease. Counts include roundoff. Reference increments are reported separately without corrections.

phone_ballistic_reference.definition: Uniform contact-free displacement v0*t + 0.5*a*t^2 = v0*t - 0.5*g*t^2 with signed g=-a from each hash-verified source deck. Actual source cards and nominal stored times are used; contact, deformation and constraints are intentionally absent from this analytic comparator.

figures.case_selection: First held-out case in frozen split order, final stored time; no error-based selection
figures.geometry: All support points at reference XY; overlapping assembly parts can hide each other. No response clipping, nodal subsampling or deformed-geometry exaggeration.

data_access_disclosure: READY/contract hashing covers every split. Each held-out FEM target is opened once after sentinel creation; metrics/figures then reuse saved memory-mapped truth and predictions. One B1 forward per held-out case, with no warm-up or repeated performance pass.
metric_memory_scope: Disk-backed aggregate float32 arrays; physical_metrics temporarily allocates channel-wise float64 fields and displacement vectors.
